notes: Pricing page lists a Premium Annual plan at $59 USD per user per month, billed annually. Contact block shows an address in Eden Prairie, MN 55346, country not stated. Integrations page lists connectors but no partner program was stated.

connections.quote: Connect your Dice account to RecruitBPM to post your jobs and get immediate access to millions of resumes worldwide.
Connect your Indeed account to RecruitBPM to post your jobs and access Indeed’s resume search directly from your RecruitBPM portal.
Post to 100+ Job Boards with One Submission directly from your RecruitBPM account using ZipRecruiter.
Connect your Careerjet account to RecruitBPM to post your jobs directly from your RecruitBPM account.
RecruitBPM and WorkHound integration gives you the ability to post your jobs directly to WorkHound your RecruitBPM portal.
Glassdoor delivers 2x better applicant quality at an average 30% lower cost per hire.
Connect with CareerBuilder to browse an extensive candidate database to search, target, and attract global talent.
Connect your Monster account to find your next great hire.
With Trovit’s job search engine functionality, gain access to thousands of classified ads all over the globe.
Connect your Job Inventory account to get access to a wide range of job seekers with their diverse talent pool.
Find talented professionals in the UK with nJobs integration for RecruitBPM Applicant Tracking System and CRM.
